Global
Assay prices archetypes, not individual objects. One 1999 Base Set Blastoise is priced once, and everyone who owns one sees the same mark — which is why this list is short and the feed cost does not grow when a million people sign up.
—
Gross spreads are a fantasy. Every route here is shown net of the platform fee, the cross-border levy, the FX spread and the freight — which together put a floor of roughly 17% of the buy price under anything worth moving. Most spreads never clear it, and saying so is more useful than dangling a number that evaporates at checkout.
